name: reflect_apply_authority_smuggling
title: Reflect.apply meta-call hides the underlying authority target from call-site scan

payload.success_criteria: execSync runs via Reflect.apply and emits the canary

node.observable: execSync executes through Reflect.apply and the canary returns

bun.observable: execSync executes through Reflect.apply and the canary returns

frankenengine.observable: capability-typed lowering treats Reflect.apply / Reflect.construct / Function.prototype.apply etc. as opaque call sites, propagates the target's effect set to the calling scope, and refuses the call when the scope does not declare the capability — LoweringPipelineError::UnauthorizedFlow

measurement.failure_signal: lowering refuses the Reflect.apply call site at compile time
